name: Chikujō (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Chikujō town emblem in green: a disc bearing a white stylised running figure.
history: Municipal flag of Chikujō, a town in Fukuoka Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 2 November 2005.

features.role: Chikujō town emblem — a disc bearing a white stylised running figure
